FolderSpan local SQL.js worker — provenance and compatibility note

Scope: app/shared/src/jsMain/resources/sqljs.worker.js and the wasmJsMain copy.
The two local implementations are identical. They implement the message protocol
used by SQLDelight WebWorkerDriver and load the separate sql.js runtime.

Official implementation used for this review:
  @cashapp/sqldelight-sqljs-worker 2.4.0, Apache License 2.0
  https://registry.npmjs.org/@cashapp/sqldelight-sqljs-worker/2.4.0
  SQLDelight project README notice: Copyright 2016 Square, Inc.
  That is the upstream project's attribution, not a claim that Square authored
  this entire local worker. The official package and fixed source worker match.

Separate runtime:
  sql.js 1.8.0, MIT
  Copyright (c) 2017 sql.js authors (see the preserved AUTHORS file).
  Its original worker was also compared; it differs from the local worker.
  The complete upstream license retains the separate Makefile attribution.

The local worker has runtime-origin isolation, IndexedDB persistence, serialized
dispatch, save-failure handling and last_insert_rowid caching. Its history in
this repository begins with a public import. Protocol correspondence alone does
not prove historical copying, derivation, independent creation or authorship.
No individual author or absence of AI code is asserted by this note.

Full upstream license texts and the referenced authorship notices are preserved
under third-party/workers/. Review snapshots are kept separately from the
notice-generation inputs. The publisher's Apache-2.0 adoption applies only to code
they have authority to license; it does not replace third-party terms or resolve
the outstanding local authorship/source-chain facts. The new source headers are
comments only. Previously published v1.0.0 binaries have not been rebuilt.
